extraction: AgentEval Benchmarks: Agentic (broad agent quality across ~60 evaluators in ~12 categories: task completion, tool-call accuracy, RAG, safety, memory, reasoning - 11 named presets), EU AI Act (dialog-level conformance against Regulation EU 2024/1689, 6 pillars, high-risk domain packs), NIST AI RMF (14 attacks mapped to NIST AI RMF MEASURE security/privacy/validity sub-actions), LongMemEval (cross-platform long-horizon memory benchmark ICLR 2025, GPT-4o baseline ~57.7%), TypedMemEval (5 embedded corpora isolating prospective, episodic, arithmetic, working-memory, forgetting - typed outcome vector), Memory (native AgentEval memory benchmark across 3/8/12 categories with weighted grading). CLI: agenteval bench <family> --preset X.
transfer_harness_fact: no paid keys (no GPT-4, no cloud GPU)
